name: 水龍巢穴
prompt: Original hand-painted pre-rendered-looking 2D isometric dark fantasy RPG game asset. Cohesive weathered stone, iron, wood and natural materials, readable midtones and clear paths, atmospheric deep shadows only around architecture, restrained warm torchlight and cool ambient fill. Crisp details at gameplay scale, no blur, no photo, no modern 3D perspective. No commercial game copies, logos, text, characters, monsters, HUD, frames or watermark. Landscape 5:3 battle map. A cold flooded cavern with blue pools around perimeter only, eroded rock columns and cyan mineral seams, broad dry gray-blue stone fighting platform. STRICT COMPOSITION: at least middle 80% width and 70% height are uninterrupted walkable flat stone ground. Every pillar, tall statue, pit, pool, obstacle and wall stays in the outside 10% border, except stairs at the very top. No painted grid. Top-down 3/4 orthographic camera, no sky. Empty environment only, no actors, dragons, HUD or text.
